description: The onFormComplete event. Each runner completes the form with a test Visa card and postal code and records the card details the native view sends; without dangerouslyGetFullCardDetails they leave out the number and CVC.

parityGaps.events.onFormComplete.card.postalCode: G17: Android's Stripe CardFormView builds its PaymentMethodCreateParams without billing details, so the event carries an empty postal code and country.
